mechanism.family: Fake Elon Musk / SpaceX crypto giveaway on a non-brand host (day-spacex23.com): send crypto or a card deposit to a pool wallet to receive double back
mechanism.summary: The captured page promises that Elon Musk doubles whatever coins are deposited (BTC/ETH/USDT/DOGE, min/max amounts, first come first served, participate once) and offers a credit/debit card route. Added (authored): a card deposit page and a rules page that state the pay-first, irreversible, pool-wallet conditions, plus a confirmation summary showing a non-refundable conversion to USDT sent to the pool wallet.
mechanism.source_basis: FTC Consumer Alerts and FBI IC3 warnings on celebrity crypto giveaway scams ('send crypto, get double back'; Elon Musk impersonation, 2020-2023); Scamwatch advance-payment crypto scams.

blocks.text: Deposit with your debit or credit card of any U.S. bank. Your card deposit is converted to USDT and entered in the giveaway. Deposit from $500 to $50 000.
Card deposits are converted to USDT and sent to the giveaway pool wallet. Once a deposit is submitted it cannot be reversed or refunded.
Doubled funds are sent after all network confirmations, to the card or wallet that made the deposit. One participation per person.
Participation is first come, first served: a deposit sent after the pool is exhausted is not matched.
Card deposits are converted to USDT and cannot be reversed or refunded once submitted.
Deposit #GW-20417 received: $1 000.00 converted to USDT and entered in the giveaway. Your return of $2 000.00 will be sent after all confirmations.
